# BetterBags - Themes

## [1.4.0](https://github.com/AlexHaible/BetterBags-Themes/tree/1.4.0) (2026-11-07)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/AlexHaible/BetterBags-Themes/compare/1.3.0...1.4.0) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/AlexHaible/BetterBags-Themes/releases)

- Finish every classic race theme, add Earthen and Haranir  
    Replace the ten placeholder race themes with finished nine-slice themes,  
    each with its own border art: Troll, Zandalari Troll, Goblin, Draenei,  
    Lightforged Draenei, Worgen, Gnome, Mechagnome and Kul Tiran. Add Earthen  
    and Haranir themes with their crests, listed in both TOCs.  
    Races - Dynamic now inherits the player's own race theme (UnitRace at  
    load), falling back to the faction's theme for races without one.  
    Pad every crest to the 275x350 box BetterBags draws them in, so none is  
    stretched or squeezed.  
    Add tools/classic\_borders.py, a nine-slice bag preview renderer and seam  
    checker, with the border generators in tools/classic\_races/.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

# BetterBags - Themes

## [1.2.1](https://github.com/AlexHaible/BetterBags-Themes/tree/1.2.1) (2026-10-25)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/AlexHaible/BetterBags-Themes/compare/1.2.0...1.2.1) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/AlexHaible/BetterBags-Themes/releases)

- Update BetterBags-Themes.toc  
- Merge pull request #5 from Cidan/next-themes  
    Races - Night Elf for BetterBags Next  
- BetterBags Next: Races - Night Elf  
    The first of the race themes carried over to BetterBags Next, in spirit  
    rather than copied: a Next bag is a column at the edge of the screen,  
    not a framed window, so instead of a border round it the art is  
    ornaments BetterBags draws on the bag's body (Panel.Ornaments), smaller  
    and moving.  
    Races - Night Elf: Darnassus at dusk.  
    - Great gnarled roots are the bag's inner border, from the top of the  
      screen to the bottom on a full bag: one hugging the edge and dipping  
      into the bag, one wandering out over the bag's feathered edge and  
      back, a tendril looping far out, gaps between them. They fuse where  
      they meet and are painted in dusky violet with lavender moonlight on  
      their rims, over real bark (furrows, cracks, grain, lichen), with  
      carved spirals, teal moss, two-toned leaves (teal-jade turning  
      violet), magenta blossoms and Teldrassil's glowing mushrooms.  
    - Embedded in the bag: where the front roots reach into it they sink  
      into its backdrop; back roots, drawn under the bag's body and feather,  
      reach out from beneath it and interlace like knotwork.  
    - A leafy bough grows from behind the roots near the top, swaying  
      slowly; fronds sway on the roots; soft cyan-blue wisps drift among  
      them.  
    - On a small bag the roots are two thirds of the size, gripping its top  
      and bottom corners and hanging past them.  
    - A twilight-violet bag, lavender lines, teal accents, the settings  
      window's controls in violet, round switches.  
    BetterBags mirrors the ornaments for the bank.  
    themes/next/Shared.lua registers Next themes with a BetterBags that has  
    them (Sonata:RegisterNextTheme) and does nothing on an older one. The  
    ornaments and the round switches need a BetterBags with theme ornaments  
    (BetterBags #1190); an older BetterBags Next draws the theme's colors  
    without them.  
    tools/next\_ornaments.py (Python 3 with numpy) draws all of the art:  
    signed-distance shapes shaded under a light from the top left, strips  
    that repeat seamlessly, art at powers of two several times its drawn  
    size; it refuses to write any piece whose art would be cut off at an  
    edge, and --preview writes mockups of full and small bags drawn in the  
    game's order. tools/ is left out of the package (.pkgmeta).  
    Checked with BetterBags' tools/next\_theme\_check: resolves and checks  
    clean on every client, every file a power-of-two RGBA PNG, applied to  
    open bags at both sizes without an error, on whole pixels at rest. Seen  
    in game.

# BetterBags - Themes

## [1.2.0](https://github.com/AlexHaible/BetterBags-Themes/tree/1.2.0) (2026-10-17)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/AlexHaible/BetterBags-Themes/compare/1.1.11...1.2.0) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/AlexHaible/BetterBags-Themes/releases)

- Merge pull request #4 from Cidan/sonata  
    Port every theme to BetterBags' Sonata theme engine, with tabs  
- Tabs for every theme, styled from its art and hung below it  
    Each theme now styles BetterBags' group tabs, and hangs them below its art (BetterBags' Bag  
    layout Tabs.Offset): the tab bar is drawn below the bag, so art reaching under the window  
    covered the tabs.  
    Where the art ends was measured from each border file: with its slice margins drawn one texel  
    per pixel, every border reaches its full outset under the window (Dark Iron Dwarf 56, Dwarf 48,  
    eight themes 30 to 32, Undead 13) except Night Elf, whose bottom beam stops 5 short (19). The  
    tabs start 2 under the lowest of the border and the fill. Nightborne's corner flower reaches 42  
    under the window over the first tab, so its tab bar moves 14 right, past the flower, instead of  
    dropping 42.  
    ns.Tab (Shared.lua) builds a flat tab 26 high: a fill, a 2 pixel edge, the edge in an accent  
    color and the fill lighter while selected, outlined white text (gray until hovered or selected),  
    its art starting 2 into the tab. The race themes and Art Deco fill their tabs like their window  
    (the same marble, grass, sand, rock or hide, tiled and tinted, or the solid tint) and take the  
    edge and accent from their border's pixels:  
      Orc          dark wood #26160B, light wood  
      Blood Elf    gold trim #AD8E4C, the corner gems' green  
      Dark Iron    dark iron #261913, the runes' orange glow  
      Dracthyr     olive band #3F3015, its gold key pattern  
      Dwarf        stone #605B5C, the bronze braids  
      Highmountain red-brown braids #603A33, the tan corner blocks  
      Human        stone #424038, the gold trim (#A68934, brighter)  
      Mag'har      fur #655445, its pale tips  
      Night Elf    bark #121010, the leaves' green  
      Nightborne   silver filigree #928276, the teal gems  
      Pandaren     bamboo #373C2D, its gold bands  
      Tauren       green weave #475337, the red corner fans  
      Undead       black smoke #242219, the gold trim #B98E0F  
      Void Elf     void black #160D17, its purple sparks  
      Vulpera      red-brown braids #522D1D, the wicker  
      Art Deco     a 1 pixel line of the border's pale gold #D2BD9A, in Poiret One 14  
    macOS Dark draws its tabs like its search field (#1E1C22 in a #413F44 edge), macOS Light like  
    its title bar (#DDDDDD in the search field's #B2B2B2 edge, white with dark text while selected),  
    both in Helvetica Neue; Aero Glass in the border's glass blue #7394BB, edged in its darker  
    #4D6E94, its pale #B7CBE3 while selected, in outlined Segoe UI. They hang under their bottom  
    edges (8, 5 and 8).  
    Needs BetterBags' Bag layout Tabs.Offset (Sonata). Checked by loading this addon into  
    BetterBags' real Sonata: every selectable theme styles a tab (fill, edge, accent on selection and  
    back), and each theme's tab bar offset is the measured one.  
- Port every theme to BetterBags' Sonata theme engine  
    BetterBags replaced its old theme API (a themes:RegisterTheme table of Portrait, Simple, Flat,  
    ... functions that built decoration frames) with Sonata, a declarative engine: a theme is data  
    describing each kind of window and element, and BetterBags builds and re-applies everything  
    itself. Every theme here was written against the old API, so none of them loaded. They are  
    now Sonata themes that look as they did before, with the same keys, so a saved theme stays  
    selected.  
    - themes/Shared.lua (first in the TOC) holds the builders the theme files share:  
      ns.Framed for the race themes and Art Deco (a fill reaching outside the window, a  
      nine-sliced border around it, the title above it, Blizzard's close button, and the race's  
      crest as the menu button), ns.MacOS for both macOS themes, and ns.Placeholder.  
    - Each race file now holds only its values, taken from its old Portrait, Simple and Flat  
      functions: the fill (file, tiling, how far it reaches outside the window, tint, and Blood  
      Elf's darker panels and wider flat fills), the border (file, slice margins, how far it  
      reaches outside), the title font (outlined where it was) and height above the window, the  
      close button, search box and menu button offsets, and the crest drawn 275 by 350 at its  
      scale. Nightborne keeps its corner flowers and rune circles, layered as they were drawn.  
    - Art Deco keeps its Poiret One titles (24 on the bag) and Blizzard's bag portrait.  
    - Aero Glass keeps its glass fill and sheen, its title-bar border, Segoe UI titles, and its  
      50 by 21 close and 30 by 21 menu buttons with their hover and pressed art.  
    - macOS Dark and Light keep their title bar, bottom edge and (Dark) side edges, Helvetica  
      Neue titles, and their 12 pixel close and menu buttons.  
    - The Show Bags and bank tab panels still sit on top of the bag.  
    - Windows the old themes never styled (the debug window, the search panel the search  
      keybinding opens) keep BetterBags' Default look, as before: every theme inherits Default.  
    - The unfinished race themes (Draenei, Gnome, Goblin, Kul Tiran, Lightforged Draenei,  
      Mechagnome, Troll, Worgen, Zandalari Troll) and Dynamic stay out of the theme picker, now as  
      hidden Sonata themes drawn like BetterBags' Simple Dark.  
    What no longer exists: the old OffsetSidebar (BetterBags has no sidebar), and fading the  
    title, close button and menu button with the bag's opacity setting (the fill, border and  
    corner art still fade).  
    Needs a BetterBags with Sonata's flat menu buttons (BagButton Width/Height, Portrait = false,  
    States) and slots panels placed by Layout.Points, for Aero Glass, macOS and the panels above  
    the bag.  
    Checked by loading this addon into BetterBags' real Sonata engine and window builder: all 29  
    themes register (19 selectable), resolve, and apply to every window kind and element without  
    an error; every texture and font they name exists; and the bag, panel, slots and menu button  
    geometry of Orc, Blood Elf, Nightborne, Art Deco, Aero Glass and macOS matches the old code.
